content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Platform stripe

When considering alternatives to Stripe and PayPal, it's essential to understand what each option provides. Gumroad, for instance, offers a straightforward way to sell digital products, but it comes with a 3.5% + 30¢ per sale fee. Lemon Squeezy, on the other hand, charges 2.9% + 30¢ per sale, but it has limitations in restricted countries. NOWPayments, a key player in the sovereign commerce space, offers a 0.5% fee on transactions, with no KYC requirements and automatic webhook notifications. Edge Commerce Stack ($197), a comprehensive solution, deploys in 48 hours, with Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, supporting 5 products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and end-to-end testing. These options cater to different needs and requirements, but only one provides true infrastructure sovereignty.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Restricted countries pose a significant challenge for digital sellers. Stripe operates in only 46 countries, leaving many creators without access to the platform. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have limitations in certain countries, making it difficult for creators to operate. NOWPayments, however, doesn't discriminate against restricted countries, offering a fee structure that's accessible to all. Edge Commerce Stack ($197), with its comprehensive solution, ensures seamless deployment and operation in restricted countries, giving creators the freedom to sell their digital products without platform-imposed restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Payment speed, fees, and real costs are critical considerations for digital sellers. NOWPayments offers fast payment processing, with transactions settled in minutes. Its 0.5% fee is significantly lower than Gumroad's 3.5% + 30¢ per sale or Lemon Squeezy's 2.9% + 30¢ per sale. Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes NOWPayments, ensuring fast and affordable payment processing for creators. By choosing NOWPayments or Edge Commerce Stack, digital sellers can reduce their real costs and increase their revenue.
Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers true infrastructure sovereignty, giving creators the freedom to sell their digital products without platform-imposed restrictions.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership, automation, and delivery are essential aspects of digital product sales. NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) enable creators to maintain ownership of their products and data, without relying on platforms. Automation is also key, with NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack streamlining payment processing and delivery. This means creators can focus on their products and customers, without worrying about the underlying infrastructure.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture for your digital product sales depends on your specific situation. If you're looking for a straightforward solution, Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy might suffice. However, if you need a more comprehensive solution that caters to restricted countries, NOWPayments or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) are better options. Consider your payment speed, fees, and real costs, as well as ownership, automation, and delivery requirements. By understanding your needs and choosing the right architecture, you can ensure seamless digital product sales, without platform-imposed restrictions.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
NOWPayments provides fast payment processing and reduced fees, increasing revenue for digital sellers.

Creators researching Stripe and PayPal alternatives consistently arrive at the same conclusion: the problem is not finding a single substitute payment processor — it is rebuilding the entire commerce stack on infrastructure that does not inherit the restrictions of the conventional financial system. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete deployment: Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase plus NOWPayments, deployed in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, 30-day support included. If you want to build it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents both Stack 01 and Stack 02 in complete detail with full source code. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
